## Requirements (Stage A, offline — this session)
- R1. Pod→server commit/deliver loop (D-P0.15d-4, load-bearing). Harness drives: harvest+read facts →
  evaluateOracle → commit(advance/gate/finalize) → on advance re-fetch runspec+re-run phase → on gate exit →
  on final assemble DeliveryArgs + deliver. Reuse orchestrator PURE oracle. No secret leaves harness.
  - Wire D-P0.15d-1 (active phase set by rigor — skip opted-out), D-P0.15d-2 (refundPhases at reduced-commit/stop),
    D-P0.15d-3 (provisional renderCredits → sdk_stream row + usage.tick per phase).
  - Unit-test over FakeEngine + fake transport + PGlite: multi-phase advance+commit, gate@approve_scope+resume,
    delivers; phase:"N" commits exactly N then stops; incomplete→guided-retry once; no secret leak.
- R2. Deployable worker: real Dockerfile (mirror api), cloudbuild worker step+image, deploy topology
  (Cloud Run min=1 + cpu-always OR GKE Deployment) in compute.ts + worker env; SA roles (GKE Job launch + secrets).
  pulumi preview clean; unit-test pure config.
- R3. api reachable by pod at API_INTERNAL_URL; api+worker share RS256 signing keypair (api verifies, worker mints).
